channel.title: Project Members on KubeSphere
channel.description: Recent content in Project Members on KubeSphere

item.title: Invite Users to a Project
item.description: This section describes how to invite users to a project. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Member Management permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. The user to be invited must first join the workspace to which the project belongs. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Member Management permissions and enter your workspace.

item.title: View Project Member List
item.description: This section describes how to view the project member list. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Member View permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Member View permissions and enter your workspace. Click Project Management > Project Members in the left navigation pane.

item.title: Modify Project Member Roles
item.description: This section describes how to modify the roles of project members. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Member Management permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Member Management permissions and enter your workspace. Click Project Management > Project Members in the left navigation pane.

item.title: Remove Project Members
item.description: This section describes how to remove project members. Note After a user is removed from a project, they will lose the permissions granted by the project role. Prerequisites You need to join a project and have the Member View permission in the project. For more information, see Project Members and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Member View permissions and enter your workspace.
